sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Yes/no questions can use the same basic word order with question intonation. Question words such as ki, mi, *hol*, mit and miért introduce information questions.

Notice mit sitting alongside mi in the question-word list — that -t is the same accusative ending you’ll formally meet later, already sneaking in early because ‘what’ so often is the object of a sentence (Mit csinálsz? ‘What are you doing?’). You’re absorbing a case ending here before you’ve even been told its name.
